sections.heading: Welcome aboard Arvia
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger guide. Not affiliated with P&O Cruises. Always follow current ship information and crew instructions.

sections.heading: Official ship information
sections.body:
P&O Cruises Arvia overview (internet required): https://www.pocruises.com/cruise-ships/arvia/overview
Use the official ship website to find current deck plans and verify cabin, venue and muster locations. Links and ship facilities can change.

sections.heading: Finding your way
sections.body: Save your cabin and muster information under Ship & Cabin. The schematic Deck Guide is for orientation only, not a verified cabin map. Venue decks remain unconfirmed until checked against the official deck plan.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Dining venues include Meridian, Zenith, Horizon, The Olive Grove, Sindhu, The Epicurean, The Keel & Cow and The Glass House. Check the onboard programme for current venues, prices and reservations.

sections.heading: Entertainment
sections.body: Arvia offers venues such as SkyDome, Headliners Theatre, The 710 Club and Ocean Studios. Check the daily programme for schedules and availability.

sections.heading: Preparing to sail
sections.body: Confirm your documents, check-in and boarding times, insurance, luggage requirements and current travel guidance before departure.

sections.heading: Ports and sea days
sections.body: Add your personal plans and port calls in My Cruise. Always follow official all-aboard times and ship announcements.

sections.heading: Offline app and backups
sections.body: Personal records are saved on this device. Use Settings to back them up before clearing browser data. Open the app online at least once before relying on offline access.

sections.heading: Advertisements and updates
sections.body: Public information and advertisements are maintained by the app owner using JSON files in the GitHub repository. Checking for updates requires internet.
